_note: Hand-maintained identity/dates only. Sample lists, file inventories, and completion status are NOT trusted from here - they are derived live by scan_*.py from the actual files on disk. Fields below copied verbatim from the previously-published data-sources.html catalog on 2026-09-17; the 'date' for cardio_wes_v350432671 looks like a last-edited stamp, not a true run date - needs a human check.

datasets.name: ALSU (original cohort - RPL GWAS)
datasets.path_note: root_path is the raw GenomeStudio export (24,258 files, 61GB - confirmed by direct audit) and correctly has no PLINK output; processed_path holds the real QC/imputation pipeline output. This is NOT stale/superseded data - per the project's own source-of-truth doc (COHORT_EXPANSION_2026_08_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md in the ALSU-analysis repo), this original 1,074/1,047-sample cohort is DELIBERATELY kept separate and used exclusively for the RPL (recurrent pregnancy loss) GWAS (Step 16), by explicit user decision, while a separate expanded cohort (see 'alsu_expanded') is used for population-genetics analyses. Two valid current datasets for two different purposes, not one dataset with a stale and a current version.
datasets.description: 1,074 post-QC samples (1,047 in the GWAS-eligible subset after phenotype mapping), 53 chip positions, general Uzbek population reference cohort. Scope: RPL (recurrent pregnancy loss) GWAS - kept intentionally separate from the expanded population-genetics cohort.
datasets.detail_note: Dedicated deep-dive site for this cohort's population-genetics workflow. Note the site documents BOTH cohorts (original + expanded) - see also 'alsu_expanded' in this catalog.

datasets.name: ALSU (expanded cohort - population genetics)
datasets.n_claimed_note: Per COHORT_EXPANSION_2026_08_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md: combined raw merge of ALSU original (1,247) + 48redone (48) + GWAS2026 wave 1 / gwas96 (95) + GWAS2026-2 (95) = 1,485 raw samples, QC'd down to 1,268 final (mind 0.20 -> 1,384; IBD dedup -> 1,326; het/KING -> 1,268). Popgen re-analysis (Steps 7-15) uses 1,256 of these post-imputation. Explicitly scoped to population-structure analyses only (PCA/ADMIXTURE/Fst/PBS/relatedness) - the RPL GWAS (Step 16) deliberately excludes this expansion and stays on the original 'alsu' cohort.
datasets.status_note: IN PROGRESS as of the source doc's writing - ADMIXTURE full parity (Uzbek-only panel + 5-seed replicates) and sNMF validation still being redone; site pages not yet updated with expanded-cohort numbers. Do not treat as a finished deliverable.
datasets.description: Population-genetics track only: original ALSU + 3 newer GSA batches (48redone, gwas96, gwas2026_2) merged, jointly QC'd and imputed as one cohort for PCA/ADMIXTURE/Fst/PBS. Distinct from and complementary to the 'alsu' entry (RPL GWAS), not a replacement for it.
datasets.detail_note: Same site as 'alsu' - covers both cohorts.

datasets.name: Cardio - October 2025
datasets.description: 12 WGS samples, cardiomyopathy pilot cohort, aggregate VCF (not per-sample).

datasets.name: Cardio - Cases / Controls / Transplant
datasets.n_claimed_note: CORRECTED from the original catalog's claimed n=65, which has no basis found anywhere on disk. Verified authoritative count: annotations/cases.tsv=12, annotations/controls.tsv=12, plus 1 separate transplant sample (Cardio1017) tracked in annotations_transplant/ - total 25. The case/control pathogenic-variant aggregation (annotations/aggregated_pathogenic_variants.json) itself reports case_count:12/control_count:12 consistently across every variant, confirming 24 for that aggregation; +1 transplant = 25 total processed samples.
datasets.sub_paths_note: cases/controls counted from these two dirs only (transplant and annotations dirs deliberately excluded from counting - transplant is 1 known sample already reflected in n_claimed, and annotations/ describes the SAME 25 samples rather than being a new batch, so scanning it too would double-count). Known caveat not yet resolved: results/ physically contains 14 sample outputs (Cardio1-12 + Cardio1017 transplant + CardioUndetermined demux leftover) rather than exactly the 12 true cases - a correct count requires filtering by annotations/cases.tsv's authoritative sample list, which this scanner does not yet do. Other real output dirs not yet counted: results_pangenome_cases/, healthy/results_pangenome_controls/ (pangenome-reference reruns of the same samples), transplant/, annotations_transplant/.
datasets.description: WGS DRAGEN germline pipeline (native single-sample naming CardioN.*, NOT the sarek/bcftools convention used by cardio_wes_v350432671). 12 cases + 12 controls + 1 transplant sample = 25 total, each with full DRAGEN output (BAM, hard-filtered VCF, coverage/QC metrics, ROH) and most also reprocessed against a pangenome reference. Pathogenic-variant aggregation exists and is real (annotations/aggregated_pathogenic_variants.json), covering the 12+12 case/control set; transplant sample annotated separately, not yet merged into the aggregation.

datasets.name: GWAS 2026 wave 1 - IDAT batch
datasets.n_claimed_note: CORRECTED from 96 (raw IDAT batch size) to 83 - the real post-variant-QC count at this batch's own final stage (gwas2026_varqc: geno/hwe/maf filtering applied, confirmed via direct .fam count). Of the original 96, 95 were successfully genotype-called (DRAGEN Array, May 2026, per COHORT_EXPANSION_2026_08_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md) and 83 remain after variant QC. Note this batch has NOT been through the same full sample-level QC (relatedness/heterozygosity/missingness) as gwas2026_2 - no qc/ side-files found, unlike gwas2026_2 - so 83 reflects variant-level filtering only, not a fully finished sample-QC'd cohort.
datasets.path_note: root_path only has raw IDATs (96 samples); processed_path has the real staged QC output (raw/sampleqc/geno10/varqc), parked in someone's admixture_analysis/temp/ working directory rather than a proper deliverable path. Also folded into the 'alsu_expanded' combined cohort (95 of the original 96 samples, before that cohort's own further joint QC).
datasets.description: 96 raw samples, 4x24 GSA chips; 95 genotype-called, 83 pass this batch's own variant-level QC. Case/control design for an unstated study (per source docs, purpose not yet resolved with the study team) - confirmed to have no bearing on its use in population-genetics analyses (ascertainment on an unrelated trait doesn't distort PCA/ADMIXTURE/Fst).

datasets.name: GWAS 2026-2 - IDAT batch
datasets.description: 87/96 post-QC samples, full PLINK+QC trail complete.

datasets.name: ALSU 48 Redone
datasets.path_note: CORRECTED from 'pending' - this WAS genotype-called (DRAGEN Array, 48/48 GTCs succeeded - a better rate than gwas2026_2's 95/96 - per COHORT_EXPANSION_2026_08_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md) and has real PLINK raw output. root_path only has raw IDATs; processed_path has the real output, parked in someone's admixture_analysis/temp/ working directory. These are rescans of specific original-cohort members whose chips catastrophically failed (verified via exact sample-sheet ID match against the original cohort). Folded into the 'alsu_expanded' combined cohort - this batch does not have a separate standalone final deliverable beyond that merge.
datasets.description: 48 samples, 2x24 GSA chips - rescans of ALSU original-cohort members whose original chips failed. Not a new/independent cohort; its downstream product is the merged 'alsu_expanded' dataset.
